description: This module provides utilities for integrating DuckDB with a per-session, in-memory data handling system. It includes functions to create session-specific databases, register pandas DataFrames as tables, list tables, describe schemas, parse SQL queries heuristically, and execute SQL with a compact result structure.

methods.name: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection _get_or_create_session_conn(session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an in-memory DuckDB connection for a given session, setting thread pragmas.

methods.name: None register_pandas_tables(session_id: str, filename: str, sheet_map: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame])
methods.description: Registers pandas DataFrames as tables within a session-specific DuckDB in-memory database, using sanitized identifiers.

methods.name: str _safe_ident(name: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to a safe identifier by lowercasing, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with underscores, collapsing underscores, and trimming.

methods.name: List[str] list_session_tables(session_id: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of table names registered in the session's DuckDB database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] explain_schema(session_id: str)
methods.description: Provides schema details (column names and types) for all tables in a session's DuckDB environment.

methods.name: Optional[str] try_parse_inline_sql(query: str)
methods.description: Attempts to heuristically extract SQL statements from user input, including code fenced blocks and common SQL start keywords.

methods.name: Tuple[str,int,int] execute_sql_compact(session_id: str, sql: str, row_limit: int = 50, col_limit: int = 24)
methods.description: Executes SQL queries in a session, returning a limited, compact TSV result for chat display, along with total row and column counts.

ctags.name: execute_sql_compact
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_sql_compact(session_id: str, sql: str, row_limit: int = 50, col_limit: int = 24) -> /
ctags.signature: (session_id: str, sql: str, row_limit: int = 50, col_limit: int = 24)

ctags.name: register_pandas_tables
ctags.pattern: /^def register_pandas_tables(session_id: str, filename: str, sheet_map: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -/
ctags.signature: (session_id: str, filename: str, sheet_map: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame])
